name: Raffles Institution
summary: Premier local boys’ independent school — IP and high-stakes academic culture.
body:
RI is a landmark local independent school. Expat families rarely enter via typical international admissions; eligibility, citizenship, and MOE pathways dominate. Included here so relocating parents understand the local top-tier landscape when comparing options for PR/citizen children. Confirm orientation / reporting timelines and parent-portal alert settings before term start — dual-career families need calendar-ready notices, not day-of WhatsApp surprises.

The Bishan campus sits near Marymount and Bishan MRT, which shapes where local-track families look for housing. Entry for non-citizens runs through narrow MOE channels, so most EP families use RI as a benchmark rather than a target. Compare its IP structure against IB schools on years-to-university, not prestige alone.
waitlistNotes: Not an international open-enrolment school — MOE rules apply.
